'''Cendence''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. He was assigned to systematically hunt down [[light Sith]] and torture them into death or darkness. However he also tried to use the position to get rid of his rivals. When approached by [[Jaesa Willsaam]], a [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] with the unique Force ability to discern any being's true nature, granted a mandate by her Master, the [[Empire's Wrath|Emperor's Wrath]], to hunt down light Sith, she realized that he was a fraud. Cendence, on the other hand, recognized that Willsaam's power would validate his work and attempted to recruit her to his side, suggesting that she frame her Master as a light Sith. However, Willsaam refused to betray her Master, before laughing in Cendence's face and bested him. Afterwards, with the support of the [[Dark Council]]'s emissary, [[Caliqu]], she took up his mantle.

==Behind the scenes==
If Jaesa follows the light path, the player has the option to encourage Jaesa to find and help Light Sith from being hunted and killed. She will kill Lord Cendence, but Jaesa will not take up his mantle.

This character exists with a placeholder model in the game files, and is called "[[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Cendence". However, he never appears nor is he referred to by that title in-game.
